verses.sloka: तौ तदा युद्ध्यमानौ तु समरे रामरावणौ ।ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि विस्मितेनान्तरात्मना ।। ६.११०.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau tadā yuddhyamānau tu samare rāmarāvaṇau ।dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni vismitenāntarātmanā ।। 6.110.1 ।।

translations.english: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मए के कहे हुए वचनों को सुन, शत्रघाती एवं परा- क्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने धनुष हाथ में ले उसके ऊपर बाण चढ़ाया

verses.sloka: अर्दयन्तौ तु समरे तयोस्तौ स्यन्दनोत्तमौ ।परस्परमभिक्रुद्धौ परस्परमभिद्रुतौ ।। ६.११०.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ardayantau tu samare tayostau syandanottamau ।parasparamabhikruddhau parasparamabhidrutau ।। 6.110.2 ।।

translations.english: Both of them were moving quickly seeking to gain one another, very furiously persevering.
translations.hindi: ओर समस्त सेना के सामने ही वे रावण के ऊपर घोर बाण- ष्टि करने लगे । इस बीच में राक्षसराज रावण दूसरे रथ पर सवार हो

verses.sloka: परस्परवधे युक्तौ घोररूपौ बभूवतुः ।मण्डलानि च वीथीश्च गतप्रत्यागतानि च ।दर्शयन्तौ बहुविधां सूतसारथ्यजां गतिम् ।। ६.११०.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: parasparavadhe yuktau ghorarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।maṇḍalāni ca vīthīśca gatapratyāgatāni ca ।darśayantau bahuvidhāṁ sūtasārathyajāṁ gatim ।। 6.110.3 ।।

translations.english: Both striking one another diligently, going in circles moving forward and backward displaying feats, went on.
translations.hindi: EN _ आजपघान महाघोरेर्धाराभिरिवः तोयदः । दीप्तपावकसङ्घाशेः शरेः काञ्चन चे वु सु ||, है युत्त शततमः सगे: १११७ बह्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर वैसे ही दोडा, जैसे राहु सूर्य के ऊपर दौड़ता हे । रथ में बैठा हुआ रावण, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर वञ्जसमान एवं महाभयानक बायाँ से वैसे ही बाण बरसाने लगा, जैसे मेघ जल बरसाते हैं। सुबर्णभूषित एवं प्रबलित अग्नि की तरह चमचमाते तीरों से

verses.sloka: अर्दयन् रावणं रामो राघवं चापि रावणः ।गतिवेगं समापन्नौ प्रवर्तननिवर्तने ।। ६.११०.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ardayan rāvaṇaṁ rāmo rāghavaṁ cāpi rāvaṇaḥ ।gativegaṁ samāpannau pravartananivartane ।। 6.110.4 ।।

translations.english: Ravana hurting Rama and vice versa displaying quickness in retaliation and speed of arrows, the fight happened.

verses.sloka: क्षिपतोः शरजालानि तयोस्तौ स्यन्दनोत्तमौ ।चेरतुः संयुगमहीं सासारौ जलदौ यथा ।। ६.११०.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṣipatoḥ śarajālāni tayostau syandanottamau ।ceratuḥ saṁyugamahīṁ sāsārau jaladau yathā ।। 6.110.5 ।।

translations.english: The network of arrows released by both of them from the chariots were like water streams from two clouds in the battlefield

verses.sloka: दर्शयित्वा तथा तौ तु गतिं बहुविधां रणे ।परस्परस्याभिमुखौ पुनरेवावतस्थतुः ।। ६.११०.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: darśayitvā tathā tau tu gatiṁ bahuvidhāṁ raṇe ।parasparasyābhimukhau punarevāvatasthatuḥ ।। 6.110.6 ।।

translations.english: Then those two, having seen many movements, once again stood facing each other in the battlefield.
translations.hindi: युद्ध, ( आकाशस्थित ) देवता गन्ववे और दानवों के कथना- नुसार बराबरी का नहीं था । तब तो सुवण से चित्रित ( सोने का पानी चढ़ा हुआ ) और सैकड़ों झुनझुनिरों से सजा हुआ

verses.sloka: धुरं धुरेण रथयोर्वक्त्रं वक्त्रेण वाजिनाम् ।पताकाश्च पताकाभिः समेयुः स्थितयोस्तदा ।। ६.११०.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhuraṁ dhureṇa rathayorvaktraṁ vaktreṇa vājinām ।patākāśca patākābhiḥ sameyuḥ sthitayostadā ।। 6.110.7 ।।

translations.english: The two chariots stood facing each other on the battlefield once more, the axle of one chariot facing the axle of another chariot, the flag of one with another flag, the standard with another standard, the face of one horse with the face of another horse stood and it seemed as though they were together.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य ततो रामो धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैः शरैः ।चतुर्भिश्चतुरो दीप्तैर्हयान् प्रत्यपसर्पयत् ।। ६.११०.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya tato rāmo dhanurmuktaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।caturbhiścaturo dīptairhayān pratyapasarpayat ।। 6.110.8 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Rama, stretching the bow, released four sharp glowing arrows at Ravana's four horses and drove them back.
translations.hindi: सूर्य के समान चमचसाते हरे रंग के घोड़ों से जुता हुआ सोने की जालियों से भूषित, सोने के बॉस में फहराती हुई ध्वजा से युक्त, इन्द्र के श्रेष्ठ रथ को

verses.sloka: स क्रोधवशमापन्नो हयानामपसर्पणे ।मुमोच निशितान् बाणान् राघवाय निशाचरः ।। ६.११०.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa krodhavaśamāpanno hayānāmapasarpaṇe ।mumoca niśitān bāṇān rāghavāya niśācaraḥ ।। 6.110.9 ।।

translations.english: Fallen prey to anger for retreating the horses, the ten headed Ravana released pointed arrows on Raghava.

verses.sloka: सो ऽतिविद्धो बलवता दशग्रीवेण राघवः ।जगाम न विकारं च न चापि व्यथितो ऽभवत् ।। ६.११०.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'tividdho balavatā daśagrīveṇa rāghavaḥ ।jagāma na vikāraṁ ca na cāpi vyathito 'bhavat ।। 6.110.10 ।।

translations.english: Raghava, though wounded by the mighty Ravana's arrows, did notexperience suffering or agitation, nor disquiet.
translations.hindi: हाथ में चाबुक लिए, रथ पर सवार इन्द्र के सारथी मातलि जे हाथ जोड़ कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा

verses.sloka: चिक्षेप च पुनर्बाणान् वज्रपातसमस्वनान् ।साराथिं वज्रहस्तस्य समुद्दिश्य निशाचरः ।। ६.११०.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: cikṣepa ca punarbāṇān vajrapātasamasvanān ।sārāthiṁ vajrahastasya samuddiśya niśācaraḥ ।। 6.110.11 ।।

translations.english: The ten headed Ravana with his thunderbolt like hands hurled arrows and struck the charioteer of Rama, making sounds like thunder.
translations.hindi: दे काकुत्स्थ ! हे महापराक्रमी महाराज! हे शत्र॒ुदमनकारिन्‌ अल इन्द्र ने, आपकी बिजय प्राप्ति के लिए यह रथ भेजा है

verses.sloka: मातलेस्तु महावेगाः शरीरे पतिताः शराः ।न सूक्ष्ममपि सम्मोहं व्यथां वा प्रददुर्युधि ।। ६.११०.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mātalestu mahāvegāḥ śarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ ।na sūkṣmamapi sammohaṁ vyathāṁ vā pradaduryudhi ।। 6.110.12 ।।

translations.english: Even though the arrows fell on Matali's body at great speed, he did not feel perturbed or experience even slight suffering.

verses.sloka: तया धर्षणया क्रुद्धो मातलेर्न तथा ऽ ऽत्मनः ।चकार शरजालेन राघवो विमुखं रिपुम् ।। ६.११०.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayā dharṣaṇayā kruddho mātalerna tathā ' 'tmanaḥ ।cakāra śarajālena rāghavo vimukhaṁ ripum ।। 6.110.13 ।।

translations.english: Rama was furious for tormenting Matali like that, but not for hurting him and in fury discharged a network of arrows on him (Ravana) and diverted him.
translations.hindi: हे बीर! सेरी रथबानी की चातुरी से देवराज इन्द्र जिस श्रकार दानवों का नाश करते हैं, उसी प्रकार आप भी इस रथ पर सवार हो कर, निशाचर रावण का विनाश कीजिये

verses.sloka: विंशतं त्रिंशतं षष्टिं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ।मुमोच राघवो वीरः सायकान् स्यन्दने रिपोः ।। ६.११०.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: viṁśataṁ triṁśataṁ ṣaṣṭiṁ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ।mumoca rāghavo vīraḥ sāyakān syandane ripoḥ ।। 6.110.14 ।।

translations.english: Heroic Raghava thereafter, let loose shafts in twenties, thirties, sixties, hundreds, and thousands at Ravana's chest.
translations.hindi: मातलि के इस प्रकार कहने पर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उस रथ की परिक्रमा की और भली भाँति उसे प्रणाम कर, उस पर वे सवार हुए । उस समय श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अपनी कान्ति से चन्द्रमा की तरह समस्त लोकों को प्रकाशित करने लगे

verses.sloka: रावणो ऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः ।गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ।। ६.११०.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo 'pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṁ pratyardayadraṇe ।। 6.110.15 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, also in return, retaliated with maces and mallets.
translations.hindi: है ए तद्वभूवाद्रुत॑ युद्ध तुमुलं रोमहषण्यम्‌ । रामस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च रक्षसः

verses.sloka: तत्प्रवृत्तं महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।। ६.११०.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatpravṛttaṁ mahadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।। 6.110.16 ।।

translations.english: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.
translations.hindi: RRS SMR cf SM Nl MRS १ लोकानूलच्म्या विराजयन्‌-चन््रग्रभत्रमेव स्वकान्त्या सर्वलोकान्‌ प्रकाशयन्‌ | ( गो० ) ११२० युद्धकाण्डे बड़े बड़े असों का चलाना और रोकना जानने वाले श्रीरामचेन्द्र जी ने रावण के चलाये गान्धर्बास्र को गान्धर्वा्ञ से ओर दैवास्न को दैवाख से काट डाला

verses.sloka: गदानां मुसलानां च परिघाणां च निस्वनैः ।शराणां पुङ्खपातैश्च क्षुभिताः सप्त सागराः ।। ६.११०.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: gadānāṁ musalānāṁ ca parighāṇāṁ ca nisvanaiḥ ।śarāṇāṁ puṅkhapātaiśca kṣubhitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ।। 6.110.17 ।।

translations.english: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

verses.sloka: क्षुब्धानां सागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः ।व्यथिताः पन्नगाः सर्वे दानवाश्च सहस्रशः ।। ६.११०.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṣubdhānāṁ sāgarāṇāṁ ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ ।vyathitāḥ pannagāḥ sarve dānavāśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 6.110.18 ।।

translations.english: By the agitation and sounds in the seas, all the Danavas and snakes in thousands inhabiting the seas got distressed.
translations.hindi: उस समय सुवरणभूषित जो बाण रावण के धनुष से छूटते “थे, वे महाविषधर सपे हो कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर गिरते थे

verses.sloka: चकम्पे मेदिनी कृत्स्ना सशैलवनकानना ।भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्न ववौ चापि मारुतः ।। ६.११०.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: cakampe medinī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā ।bhāskaro niṣprabhaścāsīnna vavau cāpi mārutaḥ ।। 6.110.19 ।।

translations.english: The entire globe with its mountains, gardens and forests shook, the Sun lost his radiance, even the wind did not blow.

verses.sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।चिन्तामापेदिरे सर्वे सकिन्नरमहोरगाः ।। ६.११०.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।cintāmāpedire sarve sakinnaramahoragāḥ ।। 6.110.20 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas, great sages, Kinneras and huge serpents all of them became anxious.
translations.hindi: प्रदीप्त फणों से युक्त महाविषधर वासुकी सर्प के तुल्य स्पशे- दिशाएँ कारी बारों से समस्त दिशाएँ भर गई

verses.sloka: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु लोकास्तिष्ठन्तु शाश्वताः ।जयतां राघवः सङ्ख्ये रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।। ६.११०.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyastu lokāstiṣṭhantu śāśvatāḥ ।jayatāṁ rāghavaḥ saṅkhye rāvaṇaṁ rākṣaseśvaram ।। 6.110.21 ।।

translations.english: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.
translations.hindi: इस लड़ाई में उन पन्नग रूपी बाणों को अपने ऊपर गिरते देख श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सर्पी को भयभीत करने वाले भयानक गरुडासन का प्रयोग किआ

verses.sloka: एवं जपन्तो ऽपश्यंस्ते देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा ।रामरावणयोर्युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम् ।। ६.११०.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ japanto 'paśyaṁste devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstadā ।rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṁ sughoraṁ romaharṣaṇam ।। 6.110.22 ।।

translations.english: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.
translations.hindi: अब तो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के धनुष से अभिशिखा के समान प्रभावाले सुबर्णपुद्ठ युक्त, खोने के जो बाण छूटते, वे सपंशत्रु गरुड बन कर सर्पा को खा लेते थे

verses.sloka: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां सङ्घा दृष्ट्वा युद्धमनूपमम् ।। ६.११०.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsarasāṁ saṅghā dṛṣṭvā yuddhamanūpamam ।। 6.110.23 ।।

translations.english: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.

verses.sloka: गगनं गगनाकारं सागरः सागरोपमः ।रामरावणयोर्युद्धं रामरावणयोरिव ।एवं ब्रुवन्तो ददृशुस्तद्युद्धं रामरावणम् ।। ६.११०.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: gaganaṁ gaganākāraṁ sāgaraḥ sāgaropamaḥ ।rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṁ rāmarāvaṇayoriva ।evaṁ bruvanto dadṛśustadyuddhaṁ rāmarāvaṇam ।। 6.110.24 ।।

translations.english: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.
translations.hindi: अपने अख को इस प्रकार विफल हुआ देख, राक्षसराज रावण ने क्रोध में भर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर बड़े भयङ्कर बाणों कीं बषो की

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहू रघूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः ।सन्धाय धनुषा रामः क्षुरमाशीविषोपमम् ।। ६.११०.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho mahābāhū raghūṇāṁ kīrtivardhanaḥ ।sandhāya dhanuṣā rāmaḥ kṣuramāśīviṣopamam ।। 6.110.25 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.
translations.hindi: दानवो ओर चारणों सहित देवता और गन कछ ग न्धवे उदास हुए | श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को पीडित देख ; सिद्ध, देवषि,

verses.sloka: रावणस्य शिरो ऽच्छिन्दच्छ्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम् ।तच्छिरः पतितं भूमौ दृष्ट्वं लोकैस्त्रिभिस्तदा ।। ६.११०.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya śiro 'cchindacchrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam ।tacchiraḥ patitaṁ bhūmau dṛṣṭvaṁ lokaistribhistadā ।। 6.110.26 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.
translations.hindi: फिर इन्द्ररथ की ध्वजा को लक्ष्य बना उसने एक बाश छोड़ा, जिससे उसने रथ पर फहराती हुई सुवर्णमयी ध्वजा को काट कर रथ से गिरा दिझ

verses.sloka: तस्यैव सदृशं चान्यद्रावणस्योत्थितं शिरः ।तत् क्षिप्रं क्षिप्रहस्तेन रामेण क्षिप्रकारिणा ।। ६.११०.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva sadṛśaṁ cānyadrāvaṇasyotthitaṁ śiraḥ ।tat kṣipraṁ kṣiprahastena rāmeṇa kṣiprakāriṇā ।। 6.110.27 ।।

translations.english: A similar looking head arose on Ravana's head. Rama, endowed with a quick hand, cut off by his hand the other head.

verses.sloka: द्वितीयं रावणशिरश्छिन्नं संयति सायकैः ।छिन्नमात्रं तु तच्छीर्षं पुनरन्यत् स्म दृश्यते ।। ६.११०.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaśiraśchinnaṁ saṁyati sāyakaiḥ ।chinnamātraṁ tu tacchīrṣaṁ punaranyat sma dṛśyate ।। 6.110.28 ।।

translations.english: Before cutting that second head of Ravana again another head appeared.

verses.sloka: तदप्यशनिसङ्काशैश्छिन्नं रामेण सायकैः ।एवमेकशतं छिन्नं शिरसां तुल्यवर्चसाम् ।। ६.११०.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadapyaśanisaṅkāśaiśchinnaṁ rāmeṇa sāyakaiḥ ।evamekaśataṁ chinnaṁ śirasāṁ tulyavarcasām ।। 6.110.29 ।।

translations.english: Rama cut off the afore said head with Indra's thunderbolt like arrows. In that way equally charming a hundred heads were struck off.

verses.sloka: न चैव रावणस्यान्तो दृश्यते जीवितक्षये ।। ६.११०.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: na caiva rāvaṇasyānto dṛśyate jīvitakṣaye ।। 6.110.30 ।।

translations.english: Rama, knower of all shastras, valiant, enhancer of Kausalya's joy, well versed in the use of weapons, was not able to see the end of Ravana's life. He started thinking.

verses.sloka: ततः सर्वास्त्रविद्वीरः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।मार्गणैर्बहुभिर्युक्तश्चिन्तयामास राघवः ।। ६.११०.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarvāstravidvīraḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ ।mārgaṇairbahubhiryuktaścintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ।। 6.110.31 ।।

translations.english: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'
translations.hindi: धूमसहित लहरों से प्रज्वलित सा होता हुआ समुद्र क्रोध में भर ऐसा उमड़ा, मानों वह सूर्य ही को छू लेगा

verses.sloka: मारीचो निहतो यैस्तु खरो यैस्तु सदूषणः ।क्रौञ्चावने विराधस्तु कबन्धो दण्डकावने ।। ६.११०.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mārīco nihato yaistu kharo yaistu sadūṣaṇaḥ ।krauñcāvane virādhastu kabandho daṇḍakāvane ।। 6.110.32 ।।

translations.english: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'
translations.hindi: सूर्य का रङ्ग काला पड़ गया, उनकी किरण मन्द पड़ गाइ । सूर्य, राक्षस राहु की गोद में धूमकेतु के साथ देख पढे

verses.sloka: यैः साला गिरयो भग्ना वाली च क्षुभितो ऽम्बुधिः ।त इमे सायकाः सर्वे युद्धे प्रात्ययिका मम ।किं नु तत्कारणं येन रावणे मन्दतेजसः ।। ६.११०.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ sālā girayo bhagnā vālī ca kṣubhito 'mbudhiḥ ।ta ime sāyakāḥ sarve yuddhe prātyayikā mama ।kiṁ nu tatkāraṇaṁ yena rāvaṇe mandatejasaḥ ।। 6.110.33 ।।

translations.english: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'
translations.hindi: सूर्यवंशियों का विशाखा नक्षत्र है, जिसके देवता इन्द्र ओर आग्नि हें । इस विशाखा नक्षत्र पर आकाश में आक्रमण कर मङ्गल जा बेठा

verses.sloka: इति चिन्तापरश्चासीदप्रमत्तश्च संयुगे ।ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि राघवो रावणोरसि ।। ६.११०.३४ ।।ा मम ।रावणो ऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः ।गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ।। ६.११०.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti cintāparaścāsīdapramattaśca saṁyuge ।vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi rāghavo rāvaṇorasi ।। 6.110.34 ।।ā mama ।rāvaṇo 'pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṁ pratyardayadraṇe ।। 6.110.35 ।।

translations.english: Even though Raghava was thinking so, yet remaining alert in the duel, rained arrows on Ravana's chest.
translations.hindi: दसमुख और बीस भुजा वाले रावण ने हाथ में धनुष ले लिया । उस संमय वह दशम्रीब ऐसा देख पडा, मानों मैनाक पवत हो

verses.sloka: तत् प्रवृत्तं महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च पुनश्च गिरिमूर्धनि ।। ६.११०.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tat pravṛttaṁ mahadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca punaśca girimūrdhani ।। 6.110.36 ।।

translations.english: Valiant enemy of Raghava also seated in the chariot, rained three hundred, sixties, hundreds, and thousands of arrows.

verses.sloka: देवदानवयक्षाणां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् ।पश्यतां तन्महद्युद्धं सर्वरात्रमवर्तत ।। ६.११०.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ piśācoragarakṣasām ।paśyatāṁ tanmahadyuddhaṁ sarvarātramavartata ।। 6.110.37 ।।

translations.english: Great war commenced in the sky, as well as on the earth, and on top of mountain again, which was horipulating,
translations.hindi: इति त्युत्तरशततमः सर्ग; ॥ किन्तु कुछ ही देर बाद रघुनाथ जो भो हें टेहो कर ओर कुछ कुछ आँखे लाल कर अत्यन्त कुपित हुए और ऐसा जान पड़ा ; मानों वे नेत्राम्नि से ( रावण को ) भस्म कर डालेंगे

verses.sloka: नैव रात्रं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न च क्षणम् ।रामरावणयोर्युद्धं विराममुपगच्छति ।। ६.११०.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: naiva rātraṁ na divasaṁ na muhūrtaṁ na ca kṣaṇam ।rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṁ virāmamupagacchati ।। 6.110.38 ।।

translations.english: The Devas, Danavas, Yakshasas also the fiends Demon, Nagas and Rakshasas watched the great war that continued for seven days and nights.

verses.sloka: दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रयोर्जयमनवेक्ष्य रणे स राघवस्य ।सुरवररथसारथिर्महान् रणगतमेनमुवाच वाक्यमाशु ।। ६.११०.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśarathasutarākṣasendrayorjayamanavekṣya raṇe sa rāghavasya ।suravararathasārathirmahān raṇagatamenamuvāca vākyamāśu ।। 6.110.39 ।।

translations.english: The fight between Rama and Ravana continued all day and night, without stopping for a moment.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे दशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११० ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe daśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 110 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the victory incline to neither the son of Dasaratha nor the lord of the rakshasas in that combat, the great-souled charioteer of the king of the gods quickly spoke this word to Raghava, intent upon the battle.
